How we know

The club's Weekly Rides page lists the Wednesday Happy Ride from Red Robin and says the start time is posted on Facebook the day before. The server copy of the page is stamped Tue Sept 29, 2026, but the page shows no ride dates and no time (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

Hosted by
West Valley Cycle ClubClub
Cost
free
Kind of ride
Road · Social

For visitors

No permits, no insurance, no dues. The club says you ride at your own risk. The start time is only on the club's Facebook group, posted the day before, so ask the club contact (on its contact page) how to get in. Bring water and lights if it's dark at the start.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
The club calls it a mid-week ride that stays together. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Happy Ride group ride

Wednesday Happy Ride is a road and social group ride in Goodyear, AZ. Schedule: Every Wednesday from the Red Robin on McDowell Road in Goodyear. The start time is posted on the club's Facebook group the day before. The route changes every week and the group rides back downwind to Red Robin, from Red Robin, Goodyear (all of the club's rides start here).

West Valley Cycle's mid-week ride. It picks a different route each week and stays together, with a downwind ride back to the Red Robin in Goodyear. The club calls it the perfect mid-week happy ride.
